verdicts.reason: A tries to restack the banner, but the result looks broken. The blue panel's diagonal cut ends in an odd white wedge at the top right. The photo sits as a hard-edged rectangle, off-centre, with white dead space to its left and below it. The white diagonal stripes are torn away from the panel and float over the hand. B keeps the original intact and legible, but it is just the shrunk banner letterboxed into a band across the middle, with about two-thirds of the canvas left as empty white. Nothing is rearranged and the text is small. B is the less damaged of the two, though neither could ship.
